note: Native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
Activity bar and secondary action bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
Viewlet header -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Search' heading and fixed icon buttons (refresh, clear, new editor, list, collapse)
Search input controls -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Search' placeholder, 'Replace' toggle, 'Match Case', 'Match Whole Word', 'Use Regular Expression' labels
Search details toggle -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Details' button
Search status message -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'No results found' or similar static status text
Editor tab actions -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Split Editor' and 'More Actions' buttons
Getting Started page -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Visual Studio Code', 'Start', 'Continue', 'Walkthroughs', 'Show on startup' and associated static descriptions
Status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Local', 'Problems', 'Notifications', 'Screen Reader Mode' and other static status labels
